instruction: A shop has 100 pens in stock. It receives an order for 150 pens and ships the whole order. How many pens does the shop have after the shipment? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
